test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: Select the sentence that gives the most appropriate meaning of the idiom ‘Keep your chin up’.

options.text: The students diligently completed their homework assignments before the deadline.
Despite facing setbacks, she remained positive and determined to achieve her goals.
The hiker enjoyed the breathtaking view from the mountaintop, taking in the natural beauty.
The scientist conducted experiments and gathered data to support his research hypothesis.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Keep your chin up"** means to remain positive and optimistic, especially during difficult times. (मुश्किल समय में सकारात्मक और आशावादी बने रहना)

 
 
• **Example: **Even after losing the match, the coach told the players to keep their chins up and focus on the next game.
 
 
 
• **Despite facing setbacks, she remained positive and determined to achieve her goals** means that even though she encountered difficulties, she stayed hopeful and focused on her objectives. (वह कठिनाइयों का सामना करने के बावजूद सकारात्मक और अपने लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करने के लिए दृढ़ संकल्पित रही)
 
 
• **Example: **After several failed attempts, he kept his chin up and eventually succeeded in passing the exam.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: The students diligently completed their homework assignments before the deadline** (छात्रों ने समय सीमा से पहले अपने होमवर्क असाइनमेंट को परिश्रमपूर्वक पूरा किया)

 
 
• **Example:** The students were praised for their diligence in completing their homework on time.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: The hiker enjoyed the breathtaking view from the mountaintop, taking in the natural beauty** (पहाड़ी पर चढ़ने वाले ने पहाड़ की चोटी से लुभावने दृश्य का आनंद लिया और प्राकृतिक सुंदरता को आत्मसात किया)
 
 
• **Example: **The hiker was mesmerized by the panoramic view from the summit.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: The scientist conducted experiments and gathered data to support his research hypothesis** (वैज्ञानिक ने अपने शोध परिकल्पना का समर्थन करने के लिए प्रयोग किए और डेटा इकट्ठा किया)
 
 
• **Example:** The scientist's thorough experiments provided strong evidence for his hypothesis.

The correct answer is option 4 i.e. in an earlier job, he will never be.
